meta_description:
60 likes, 1 comments - assetyogi on September 17, 2026: "New UPI guidelines kick in from 15th October, but will you have to pay anything extra? Here is the complete breakdown:

P2P Payments (Friends & Family)

100% FREE! No matter how much money you transfer to your friends, family, or self-accounts, there are zero charges.

Daily Shopping

Payments up to ₹2,000 carry ZERO charges for the merchant.
Payments above ₹2,000 attract a 0.4% MDR paid by the merchant (You pay ₹0 extra!).

Small Vendors & Kirana Stores

Small shopkeepers receiving up to ₹1 Lakh/month via UPI QR remain completely exempt with NIL charges.

Bills & AutoPay

No new charges on your monthly utility bills, OTT subscriptions, or EMI auto-debits.

Special Categories

Train Tickets, Fuel, Telecom & Insurance → Flat ₹5 charge (Paid by the merchant).
Shares & Mutual Funds → Just 0.02% (Max capped at ₹300), borne by your broker or fund house

[UPI Rules 2026, UPI MDR 2026, UPI Charges]

#upi #assetyogi #finance".
